explanation: Faithfully encodes the 'in particular' question on erdosproblems.com/130 in the affirmative: there is an infinite planar set in general position (no three collinear, no four concyclic) whose integer-distance graph (adjacent iff the distance is a positive integer) has infinite chromatic number. The clique-number part is explicitly left out, as the docstring says. The solved status rests on the linked formal proof; my cached copy of the page records no resolution, so I could not cross-check it there.
